scope: Three upstream Git progress automatic close policies in seven native workflows. Full application and distribution parity remains incomplete.

verification.native: Four-Git real repository receiver passed all three policies across Commit, Fetch, merge Pull, Merge, Abort Merge, Stash Save and express Switch. Zero-action successful Merge/tag, Merge Abort and no-change Stash close in modes 1/2; available actions retain mode 1 and close mode 2 without dispatch. Fetch, Pull, Merge and Switch failures stay open in all modes. Actual Commit hook rejection stays open in mode 2 and retains owner/draft after acknowledgement. Snapshot/reopen preferences and absent/invalid fallback preserve raw values. Hidden settings host lays out in private preferences without a window; no physical picker claim.
verification.regressions: Existing Commit progress and Pull progress receivers passed all four Gits, including hook cancellation and result actions, conflict and unrelated-history handling and Stash follow-up chain. Core unchanged; prior Core checks not repeated.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and AppStore builds and bundle audits passed: Finder extension, licenses, EditorConfig/IssueRegex and 98 upstream icons. NOTICE byte-identical in both. Store Git 2.55.0 universal runtime audit and local fixture operations passed. No signed acceptance claim.
verification.documentation: Source pin checker passed; 3277 source rows each seven columns. Four partial mappings updated, README/Commit parity/new Progress parity and native CI step added. Local site build recorded separately; unpublished.
verification.processes: All native/Debug compiler sessions terminated before Store build. No main GUI launches or displayed windows. Private prohibited-activation receivers; no standard preferences or clipboard writes. Twelve empty owned UUID preference plists removed after termination; zero nonempty files changed. Process audit empty.
verification.limitations: Other progress windows including Push, CLI closeonend override, libgit2 variants, streaming and full controls/layout, physical picker/Close/Escape/default/nested-sheet/theme/accessibility, split cancellation and signed sandbox/Finder/App Store acceptance pending. Native retries reusing a sheet retain captured policy; upstream callbacks may construct a fresh progress instance. Existing source-specific success-close and accepted-cancellation overrides retained. Screenshots predate this setting. Full file/dialog/application port and hosted CI/site/distribution incomplete; GitHub authorization unavailable and not retried.
